# NHS Borders

> NHS Borders provides comprehensive healthcare services across the Scottish Borders region, offering patient services, hospital care, mental health support, and community wellbeing resources.

NHS Borders serves the Scottish Borders community with facilities including Borders General Hospital and multiple community hospitals. The organization emphasizes patient engagement, value-based care, and accessibility across all services.

## Key Topics

- Patient Services
- Hospital Visiting
- Outpatient Appointments
- Mental Health & Wellbeing
- Vaccination Programmes
- Telemedicine (NHS Near Me)
- Borders General Hospital
- Community Hospitals
- Patient Feedback & Complaints
- Accessibility
- Value-Based Care
- Healthcare Access
- RAAC Remedial Works
- Home First Programme
- Scottish Borders

## Patient Services & Access

- [Patients & visitors](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk): NHS Borders homepage with patient services, appointments, and local healthcare access
- [Patients & visitors](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors): Main patient services hub with hospital visiting, appointments, and vaccination programs
- [Going to Hospital](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/going-to-hospital): Hospital visit preparation guide for Borders General and community hospitals
- [Near Me](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/nhs-near-me): Guide to NHS Near Me video consultation and telemedicine services
- [Contact Us](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/contact-us): Contact information, phone numbers, and office hours for NHS Borders services

## Health & Wellbeing

- [Helping yourself and others](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/creating-hope): Mental health support, suicide prevention, and community wellbeing resources
- [Find A Service](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/mental-health-wellbeing): Mental health services directory with local support and wellbeing resources
- [Vaccination Programmes](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/vaccination-programmes): Meningitis vaccination schedules, eligibility, and outbreak response information
- [Value Based Health & Care](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/value-based-health-care): Value-based care approach, shared decision-making, and patient engagement

## Hospital Services & Infrastructure

- [Knoll Hospital (RAAC)](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/knoll-hospital-(raac)): RAAC remedial works, service relocation, and temporary arrangements at Knoll Hospital
- [Our Future Direction](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/our-future-direction): Strategic vision for NHS Borders healthcare excellence and continuous improvement

## Patient Support & Engagement

- [Patient Experience Team](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/feedback-and-complaints): Patient feedback, complaints process, and Patient Advice and Support Service
- [Get Involved](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/get-involved): Public involvement opportunities and community participation in NHS Borders
- [Accessibility](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/our-services/general-services/accessibility): WCAG compliance and accessibility statement for screen readers and keyboard navigation

## Organizational Information

- [Corporate Information](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/corporate-information): Board members, leadership team, and organizational structure of NHS Borders
- [About the Board](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/corporate-information/about-the-board): Board overview, governance structure, and performance reporting for NHS Borders
- [Key publications](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/corporate-information/key-publications): Archive of research reports, annual reports, and governance documents

## Optional

- [Freedom of Information](https://www.nhsborders.scot.nhs.uk/corporate-information/freedom-of-information): FOISA requests, publication scheme, and transparency accountability information
